title: Authorization span of the fills a moved Prescriptions & Renewals prescription still holds
content:
**Medication Management Office standard — Prescriptions & Renewals prescriptions moved to a retail pharmacy.**

**1. The authorization-span allowance.** The authorization-span allowance follows the fills the prescription still authorizes, the per-fill days' supply the prescription carries before the move, and the calendar days from the day of the move to its expiration date: where at least one fill remains and those fills, each at the per-fill days' supply the prescription carries, would run past the expiration date, it is those days divided evenly among the fills remaining, rounded down to a whole day; where at least one fill remains and those fills would end on or before the expiration date, it is the per-fill days' supply the prescription carries; where no fill remains, it is the retail standard of 30 days.

**2. Definitions.**
2.1 *Days to the expiration date* — the number of calendar days by which the expiration date falls after the day of the move; a move on the day before the expiration date gives 1.
2.2 *Run past the expiration date* — the fills remaining multiplied by the per-fill days' supply is more than the days to the expiration date. When that product is equal to or less than the days to the expiration date, the fills end on or before it.
2.3 *Divided evenly* — the days to the expiration date divided by the number of fills remaining, any fraction of a day dropped.

**3. Condition — method table.**

| Fills remaining | Fills at the carried per-fill days' supply | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | run past the expiration date | days to the expiration date divided by the fills remaining, rounded down |
| 1 or more | end on or before the expiration date | the per-fill days' supply carried before the move |
| none | — | 30 days |

**4. Worked cases (hypothetical).**
- 3 fills remain at 90 days each and the expiration date is 200 days away: 270 days would run past it, so 200 divided by 3 is 66.67, and the allowance is 66 days.
- 2 fills remain at 45 days each and the expiration date is 90 days away: the fills end exactly on the expiration date, so the allowance is 45 days.
- 2 fills remain at 30 days each and the expiration date is 100 days away: the fills end before it, so the allowance is 30 days.
- No fill remains: the allowance is 30 days.
